item.title: Self-Hosted BLDC Motor Controllers: ODrive vs VESC vs SimpleFOC for Open-Source Precision Motor Control
item.description: Brushless DC (BLDC) motors power everything from drone propellers to CNC spindles to robotic arms. But precision control requires sophisticated firmware that does more than just spin a motor — it needs Field-Oriented Control (FOC), sensor feedback loops, and configurable motion profiles. Three open-source platforms dominate the DIY motor control landscape: ODrive, VESC, and SimpleFOC. Each takes a distinctly different approach to the same problem.
